shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin drops below $84K; $145M long liquidations hit market due to strong US economic data and rising Treasury yields.
Ethereum underperforms; derivatives sentiment turns negative after hack, with $49.8M in liquidations.
Trump-EU trade deal announced to reduce global economic uncertainty, but Bitcoin's reaction is muted.
Overall crypto market sentiment is 'Fear' amid macro pressures, with US Treasury yields exceeding 5% impacting risk assets.
Litecoin & Ondo gain despite market dip; Litecoin surged on network activity, and Ondo gained from a BlackRock partnership.
